views.label: Evidence
views.note: Provider signatures over CommitmentPayload from POST /commit or GET /commitment, or the on-chain snapshot for a cold bucket.

views.label: Create
views.note: The pallet checks the caller, the live agreement and the leaf, holds ChallengeDeposit and stores the challenge under its deadline.

views.label: Defend
views.note: A valid response before the deadline leaves the stake untouched. The pool drops a second response, or one racing a cancel, without a fee.

views.label: Timeout and slash
views.note: After the deadline anyone calls resolve_expired_challenge: full stake of a physical provider, per_provider_stake per signer of a virtual.

segments.label: Evidence: what the provider committed to
Create: checks, deposit, deadline, further signers
Before the deadline: challenger cancels or provider responds

messages.label: mmr_root, start_seq, leaf_count, leaf_indices, provider_signatures
messages.note: signed over CommitmentPayload { version, genesis_hash, bucket_id, agreement_id, commitment }

messages.label: challenge_checkpoint | challenge_offchain(agreement_id, commitment, provider_signatures) | challenge_replica
messages.note: checks SelfChallenge, NotAuthorizedForPrivateBucket, AgreementNotFound, AgreementExpired, ChallengedLeafDeleted

messages.label: Challenges[deadline, index]; provider pending_challenges += 1
messages.note: deadline = now + ChallengeTimeout; copies agreement_id, commitment, kind, snapshot, liable, authorized

messages.label: extend_challenge(challenge_id, additional_signatures)
messages.note: anyone; virtual provider, off-chain challenge only: adds snapshotted members to the liable set

messages.label: cancel_challenge(challenge_id)
messages.note: challenger only; full deposit refunded, only the tx fee is lost

messages.label: respond_to_challenge(challenge_id, response)
messages.note: Proof (chunk_data, chunk_proof, mmr_proof) | Deleted | Superseded (not for a replica challenge); virtual: any snapshotted member

messages.label: fee share to provider, excess to challenger
resolve_expired_challenge(challenge_id)
messages.note: anyone may call, free on success; ChallengeNotExpired while anchor <= deadline

messages.label: slash to the Treasury, release ChallengeDeposit
messages.note: physical: full ProviderStake; virtual: per_provider_stake per signer; challenger made whole, no reward

messages.label: remove_slashed(bucket_id, provider)
messages.note: anyone; physical provider, live agreement, locked_stake < agreement.stake

cards.title: Which challenge extrinsic
items: challenge_checkpoint: cold buckets, snapshot as evidence
challenge_offchain: hot buckets, the signed commitment and its agreement_id; the chain rebuilds CommitmentPayload with its own genesis hash and rejects a commitment whose agreement is no longer live
challenge_replica: replicas, confirmed sync root as evidence (virtual: last_sync_signers are liable)
extend_challenge: anyone adds further snapshotted members' signatures to an open off-chain challenge against a virtual provider

cards.title: Invalid and duplicate responses
items: Rejected with InvalidProof, InvalidDeletionClaim or InvalidSupersededClaim; the provider pays the tx fee
The challenge stays open; the provider may answer again before the deadline
Only a timeout slashes: resolve_expired_challenge after the deadline
Transaction extension for raced calls: the pool drops a second response to the same challenge, or one racing cancel_challenge, without a fee

cards.title: pending_challenges
items: Counts open challenges per provider (virtual: the synthetic account); decremented once per resolution: defended, cancelled or timed out
While above 0, every stake lock of the provider stays active and deregister_provider fails; a challenged virtual provider locks all its members' stake
The payment is not held: the challenge contains everything its resolution needs, so the agreement can settle while it is open
